motion.subject_motion: The woman gently moves her hands while arranging jasmine flowers; the jasmine strands sway naturally. The man makes a small natural adjustment to his angavastram. The child takes one slow step toward the kolam and looks down at it. Clothing edges and jasmine flowers respond subtly to a gentle morning breeze. All facial expressions remain natural and calm. Background household activity moves very subtly. No exaggerated gestures or sudden movements.
motion.camera_move: A slow, smooth cinematic dolly-in of approximately 1 meter toward the family from the courtyard entrance, maintaining the original eye-level perspective and 35mm field of view. Very subtle natural handheld micro-movement, stabilized and documentary-like. Keep the Chettinad architecture stable and geometrically accurate throughout the shot.
motion.environment_motion: Soft morning breeze gently moves jasmine flowers, saree fabric and the angavastram. A few leaves in the background move slightly. Natural ambient movement only; architecture and major objects remain stationary.
